content: Bautisac Juanda huanchishcamanda
Herodesca Galilea gubirnadur aushcaimi Jesus pihuas mana rashcagunata ashcata rashcamanda uyara runagunatas janbishcamandas.
Chita uyasha paita cuirac runagunata rimara, Bautisac Juanmi causarishca, chasna causarisha ashca ushaihuanmi puriun nisha ashcata manzharira.

Ñáaupallata mandac amu Herodesga paihua cachunllatata japira paihua huauqui Felipeta quichusha. Chi huarmiga Herodías shutiyug mara. Chasna quichusha japishcamandami Herodestaga Juanga caran cutin camachic ara casna nisha, canga mana alitachu rashcangui camba huauquihua huarmita quichusha japishcamanda nisha. Chasna camachicpimi chi Herodesca paihua runagunataga mandara Juanda japisha huatasha carcelbi tapaichi nira.
Tucui runagunaga yuyarinaurami Juanga Dios rimashcata pasachic man nisha. Chasnamandami amu Herodesca Juanda huanchisha nisha yuyarishallata runagunata manzhasha mana imata rara.
Chasna rashcahuashami amu Herodes pagarishca punzha pactacpi jistata ranaura. Chi jistaibimi paihua ushushi tucuc tucui cayashca runaguna ñaupacpi bailasha amu Herodesta ashcata cushiyachira.
Chasna cushiyaushami, Can munashcata tapuhuai, ñucaga cushcanguillami nisha paita rimara.
Chasna nicpi chi ushushi tucuc amu Herodesta tapura paihua mama cunashcacuinta, Bautisac Juanba umata shuc pulatui cuhuangui nisha.

Chasna tapushcata uyasha amu Herodes yapa llaquirira. Chasna agllaita chibi tiyaucuna ñaupacpi can munashcata cushcanguimi nishcamandami carcelbi Juan auta paihua umata pitigrichi nisha sundalugunata cachara.
Huanchishcahuasha Juanba umata shuc pulatui churasha Herodíaspa ushushima cunaura. Chihuasha chi ushushi paihua mamata cura.
Chasna huanchishcata uyasha Juanda caticcuna paihua aichata apasha pambanaura. Chihuasha Jesusta cuintagrinaura.
Jesus pichca huaranga (5.000) runata carashcamanda

Bautisac Juanda huanchishcata uyasha Jesus chi partimanda llucshishun runaguna illashca partima rishun nisha canuaibi yaicusha chimbanaura. Randi runaguna chita yachashaga llactagunamanda llucshisha mayanllata chaquihuanlla apanacunaura.
Jesus ña canuamanda llucshisha ashca runagunata ricusha llaquirisha yanapanata munara. Chasna acpi tucui chibi auc ungushcagunata janbira.

Chasna paiguna aushcai tutayaupi pai japishca runaguna paihuagma caillayasha ninaura, Ñáa tutayaunmi, cai mayanllaiga huasiguna illanmi, chasna acpi cai runagunata cachai, paiguna chi llacta mayangunai micunata randigrinauchun.
Chasna nicpi Jesus paigunata randi nira, Mana minishtirinzhu paiguna chima ringahuaca, cangunallata caraichi.
Chita uyasha rimanaura, Pichca (5) panllata chimanda ishcai (2) yacu aichallata charinchi. Chillami tiyan ninaura.
Chasna ninaupi Jesus nira, Chillatas apamuichi.

Apamunaupi runagunata quihua jahuai tiyarichi nira. Chihuasha chi pichca pandas ishcai yacu aichatas japisha, jahuama ricusha Diosta pagrachu nira. Chasna pagrachushcahuasha panda partisha pai japishca runagunama cura, paiguna randi tucui runagunama cunaura micunauchun nisha.
Tucuigunami sacsacta micunaura. Micushcahuasha Jesus japishca runaguna puchucta tandasha chunga ishcai (12) ashangata jundachinaura.
Chi micuc carigunallashi pichca huaranga (5.000) tupu anaushcaya, huarmigunatas huahuagunatas mana yupagllaita.
Jesus yacu jahuata purishcamanda
Chihuasha Jesus pai japishca runagunata nira canguna canuai yaicusha chimbama ñaupasha richi runagunata ñuca dispirinagama.
Pai dispirishcahuasha sapalla urcuma sicara Dioshuan cuintanacungahua. Ñáa tuta aushcai paillami chillaita chara aura.
Chi canuai riucunaga chaupi cuchata cahuirisha riushcai sinzhi huaira shamucpi canua cadsi tigrara.
Ñáa punzhayana partibi Jesus paigunahuagma shamura yacu jahuata purisha.
Chi canuai auc runaguna pai yacu jahuata purimucta ricusha yapa manzharinaura. Jesus acta mana yachasha ayachari an nisha manzharisha caparinaura.
Chasna caparinaupi Jesus uctalla paigunata, Ñáuca mani, ama manzharisha cushiyaichi nira.
Jesus rimashcata uyasha Pedroga nira, Can ashaga cambagma yacu jahuata shamui nisha rimahuai señor.
Jesus shamui nicpi Pedro canuamanda llucshisha yacu jahuata purisha Jesuspagma riura.
Randi yapa sinzhi huairaushcata ricusha manzhasha yacu ucuma pambaringahua callarira. Chasna tucusha, quishpichihuai señor nisha caparira.
Caparicpi Jesus maquimanda japisha nira, Ashilla quiric mangui, imangahuata manzharingui.
Ñáa paiguna canuaibi yaicushcallahuan huaira saquirira.
Chi barcoi aucuna Jesuspa ñaupacpi cungurisha ninaura, Sirtupacha can Diospa churi mangui nisha.
Genesaret partibi ungushcagunata janbishcamanda
Ñáa paiguna cuchata chimbasha Genesaret nishca partima pactasha llutarinaura.
Chibi causauc runaguna Jesusta ricsisha tucui partigunama shimita cachanaura Jesus shamushcami nisha. Chita uyasha ungushcagunata paihuagma apamunaura janbipachun nisha.
Paihuagma apamusha paita ruganaura, Ungushca runaguna can churariushca llachapa pundahuallatas llanganauchun nisha. Chasna acpi tucui llangac runaguna janbirinaurami.
